puzzle.hint: Allah's reward and guidance for the patient who say 'Indeed we belong to Allah' in calamity
puzzle.arabic: أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ عَلَيْهِمْ صَلَوَٰتٌۭ مِّن رَّبِّهِمْ وَرَحْمَةٌۭ ۖ وَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُهْتَدُونَ
puzzle.verseEn: Those are the ones upon whom are blessings from their Lord and mercy. And it is those who are the [rightly] guided.
